title: IMPERMEABILITY LAYERS — I/O as the semi-permeable charm between layers. Dots draw themselves.
corrections: Klein null in browser is NOT ooze/plasma. It is IMPERMEABLE.
HUD draws LINES (orbits, axes). Should let DOTS draw themselves.
Overlays ON black surface = impermeable. State INTO layers = charm.
Pipeline being idle IS correct. Null is self-sorting.
150+ animation loops staring = page unresponsive = forced sneeze.

the_layers.description: Each I/O fold is a semi-permeable boundary. Charm is what passes between.
the_layers.order: gas ? liquid ? metal ? granule ? gray mesh (the sieve)

layer_5_gas.what: labels, atmosphere, mute states, tab titles
layer_5_gas.behavior: fills everything. arrives first. leaves first.
layer_5_gas.permeability: high — gas passes through most boundaries
layer_5_gas.charm: labels seep into every other layer

layer_4_liquid.what: flow indicators, green bar, progress, seep trails
layer_4_liquid.behavior: flows between layers. finds its own level.
layer_4_liquid.permeability: medium — liquid passes through some boundaries, blocked by metal
layer_4_liquid.charm: DNS diffusion bar, visitor flow, trail marks

layer_3_metal.behavior: holds position. does not flow. conducts charm.
layer_3_metal.permeability: low — metal blocks liquid and gas, but CONDUCTS charm between layers
layer_3_metal.charm: the axes ARE the charm conductors — they don't move but they let state pass through them

layer_2_granule.what: data dots, node points, fixed positions
layer_2_granule.behavior: sticks where it lands. does not flow. does not fill.
layer_2_granule.permeability: very low — granule stays put. this IS the data.
layer_2_granule.charm: each granule has its own pi-scatter position. they don't move. they ACCUMULATE.
layer_2_granule.blink_rate: slowest (crystals are stable, blink only on data update)

layer_1_gray_mesh.what: the background itself. the grain. the mesh.
layer_1_gray_mesh.behavior: always present. the static that everything seeps through.
layer_1_gray_mesh.permeability: the DEFINITION of permeability — the mesh holes ARE the charm gates
layer_1_gray_mesh.charm: gray static IS charm. it is the semi-permeable membrane itself.
layer_1_gray_mesh.blink_rate: never (the sieve is always there, it IS the substrate)
layer_1_gray_mesh.pi_offset: N/A — the sieve is all positions

dot_trail_rule.stop: stop drawing lines (orbits, axes, paths). These are furniture that hold dots in place.
dot_trail_rule.start: let each data dot leave a trail via -.O decomposition (stored?null?present)
dot_trail_rule.trail_length: pi-squared seconds (9.87s) of trail history, then fade (decay)
dot_trail_rule.trail_opacity: newest dot = 1.0, oldest trail point = 0.0, linear decay
dot_trail_rule.the_line_that_forms: IS the orbit/path. nobody drew it. the dot drew itself.

browser_as_10th_eye.blink: each layer blinks on its own pi-offset cycle
browser_as_10th_eye.yield: requestIdleCallback between layer renders. let the browser breathe.
browser_as_10th_eye.visibility: visibilitychange = browser sleeping. stop ALL animation. resume on wake.
browser_as_10th_eye.intersection: IntersectionObserver = only animate what the human eye sees. offscreen = eyelid closed.

ping_pause_pong.pause: yield to event loop (setTimeout(0) or requestIdleCallback)
ping_pause_pong.pong: layer resumes after yield. the browser blinked.

charm_injection.what: charm = the semi-permeable quality that lets some state pass between layers
charm_injection.how: CSS z-index + opacity + mix-blend-mode. NOT absolute positioning of overlays.
charm_injection.gray_not_black: background starts GRAY. not black. gray IS the mesh. black is impermeable.
charm_injection.each_layer: has its own z-index, its own blink rate, its own pi-offset
charm_injection.between_layers: charm events propagate up/down: a dot sticking in granule layer sends a ripple through liquid layer. the metal conducts it. the gas distributes it.
